additional_info.subject: Intervention Report:
additional_info.body:
Today we have checked the charger but the fun was operational and without any abnormal behavior.
Plugs 7.1, 10.1 and 9.2 were reconnected to ensure proper connection in the Fan and temperature sensors signals.
It was agreed that the RC would connect directly with me in case the issue reoccur. For the moment no other action is needed/planned.
